name: Modbus TCP Gateway
Read registers HR0-HR10 (click for details)
info:
### Read registers (Arduino to Ignition)
Updated once per second from the Arduino's JSON frame.

| Register | Signal | Scaling |
|---|---|---|
| HR0 | Temperature | x10 (245 = 24.5 °C) |
| HR1 | Humidity | % |
| HR2 | Light level | % |
| HR3 | Obstacle detected | 0/1 |
| HR4 | Relay output | 0/1 |
| HR5 | Mode | 1 = AUTO, 0 = MANUAL |
| HR6 | Setpoint | x10 |
| HR7 | High temperature alarm | 0/1 |
| HR8 | Run status | 0/1 |
| HR9 | DHT11 sensor OK | 0/1 |
| HR10 | Heartbeat counter | increments every second |

name: Command registers HR20-HR26 (click for details)
info:
### Command registers (Ignition to Arduino)
These work as pulses: write a value, the gateway sends the command over serial, and the register goes back to 0.

| Register | Command | Values |
|---|---|---|
| HR20 | New setpoint | x10 (275 = 27.5 °C) |
| HR21 | Mode | 1 = AUTO, 2 = MANUAL |
| HR22 | Relay (MANUAL only) | 1 = ON, 2 = OFF |
| HR23 | Alarm reset | 1 |
| HR24 | Silence buzzer (MUTE) | 1 |
| HR25 | Run / stop | 1 = RUN, 2 = STOP |
| HR26 | Output test | 1 |
